title: Dermal fillers
caption: Dermal fillers add volume - they don't relax muscles, that's Botox. The vast majority are hyaluronic acid gels that gradually dissolve over 6-18 months and, crucially, can be reversed with an enzyme if you're not happy with the result. Other types (calcium-based, collagen-stimulators) need a steadier hand because they can't be undone the same way. Knowing which kind is going under your skin changes what 'reversible' actually means for you. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
